segments.he:
א.

לִפְעָמִים כְּשֶׁאָדָם עוֹשֶׂה מִצְוָה, וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ- בָּרוּךְ-הוּא מַעֲנִישׁ אוֹתוֹ, זֶה מֵחֲמַת שֶׁלֹּא עָשָׂה מִצְוָה כָּזֶה, כְּשֶׁבָּאָה לְיָדוֹ.
segments.en: Sometimes, when a person performs a Mitzvah (Divine commandment/good deed) and the Holy One, Blessed be He, punishes him, this is because he did not perform a similar Divine commandment when he had the opportunity to do so.

segments.he:
ב.

לִפְעָמִים דָּנִין אֶת הָאָדָם עַל פִּיו.
segments.en: Sometimes a person is judged according to his own words. (t.n see Likutay Moharan 113)

segments.he:
ג.

לִפְעָמִים הָאָדָם נֶהֱרָג, מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהָיָה יָכוֹל לְהַמְלִיץ בְּעַד אֶחָד, שֶׁשּׂוֹנְאִין אוֹתוֹ בְּחִנָּם.
segments.en: Sometimes a man is murdered because he had the ability to advocate on behalf of someone who was being hated for no reason.

segments.he:
ד.

לִפְעָמִים הָאָדָם נֶעֱנָשׁ, עַל שֶׁפָּשַׁע בִּמְלַאכְתּוֹ, אוֹ שֶׁנִּגְזַר גְּזֵרָה עַל אַנְשֵׁי מְקוֹמוֹ אוֹ עַל עַמּוֹ.
segments.en: Sometimes a man is punished because of negligence in his work, or because a decree had been passed upon the people of his community or upon his nation.

segments.he:
ה.

הַקָּדוֹשׁ-בָּרוּךְ-הוּא מְמַהֵר לְהִפָּרַע מִכְּפוּיֵי טוֹבָה עַל-יְדֵי כְּפוּיֵי טוֹבָה.
segments.en: The Holy One, Blessed be He, is swift to punish those who are ungrateful, through the agency of those who are ungrateful.

segments.he:
ו.

מִי שֶׁכֶּלֶב נָשַׁךְ אוֹתוֹ, בְּיָדוּעַ שֶׁקִּבֵּל לָשׁוֹן הָרָע, אוֹ שֶׁסִּפֵּר לָשׁוֹן הָרָע.
segments.en: Someone who was bit by a dog, it is certain that he accepted slander (lushon hura) or spoke slander.
